briefdescription.para: Enables the specified interrupts in the device.

parameterdescription.para: 64 bit-mask of the interrupts to be enabled. Bit positions of 1 are enabled. Bit positions of 0 keep the previous setting. This mask is formed by OR'ing XSYSMONPSU_IER_0_* and XSYSMONPSU_IER_1_* bits defined in xsysmonpsu_hw.h.

briefdescription.para: Disables the specified interrupts in the device.

parameterdescription.para: 64 bit-mask of the interrupts to be disabled. Bit positions of 1 are disabled. Bit positions of 0 keep the previous setting. This mask is formed by OR'ing XSYSMONPSU_IDR_0_* and XSYSMONPSU_IDR_1_* bits defined in xsysmonpsu_hw.h.

briefdescription.para: Returns the enabled interrupts read from the Interrupt Enable Register.

detaileddescription.para: Use the XSYSMONPSU_IER_0_* and XSYSMONPSU_IER_1_* constants defined in xsysmonpsu_hw.h to interpret the returned value.

simplesect.para: A 64-bit value representing the contents of the Interrupt Mask Registers (IMR1 IMR0).

briefdescription.para: Returns the interrupt status read from the Interrupt Status Register.

detaileddescription.para: Use the XSYSMONPSU_ISR_0_* and XSYSMONPSU_ISR_1_ constants defined in xsysmonpsu_hw.h to interpret the returned value.

simplesect.para: A 64-bit value representing the contents of the Interrupt Status Registers (ISR1 ISR0).

briefdescription.para: Clears the specified interrupts in the Interrupt Status Register.

parameterdescription.para: 64 bit-mask of the interrupts to be cleared. Bit positions of 1 are cleared. Bit positions of 0 do not change the previous interrupt status. This mask is formed by OR'ing the XSYSMONPSU_ISR_0_* and XSYSMONPSU_ISR_1_* bits which are defined in xsysmonpsu_hw.h.

briefdescription.para: Implements interrupt handling for the SYSMONPSU driver.

detaileddescription.para: This file contains functions related to SYSMONPSU interrupt handling.
